privacy.title: Privacy and cookies
privacy.description: How Ayvago handles your data, cookies and ads, and your rights under the GDPR.
privacy.intro: Ayvago (ayvago.com) is a free web game platform. This page explains what we store about you, which cookies and similar technologies we use, how ads work, and your rights under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

data.title: What we store
data.p1: When you play, you get a guest account; you can also sign in with Google. We store your username, avatar and character, your settings (theme, language), your library (favourites, recently played), your scores, play statistics, achievements and votes. Signing in with Google adds your email address to the account.
data.p2: The data is kept in Google Firebase in the European Union (europe-west1, Belgium). Games run in a sandbox and never receive your account data; they only get what they need to play, such as your chosen character and your best score.
data.p3: On your Profile page you can download all your data or delete your account at any time. Unused guest accounts are deleted after 30 days.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.p1: Necessary storage keeps the site working: your language (a cookie), your theme, your sign-in session and a copy of your library in the browser. It needs no consent and is never used for advertising.
storage.p2: We do not use analytics cookies. Ad cookies are used only while ads are on and only with your consent (see below).

ads.title: Ads
ads.p1: Ads keep Ayvago free. The Ayvago page shows them itself, through Google AdSense (H5 Games Ads); games never show ads on their own. There are three kinds: rewarded ads you choose to watch for a reward in a game, short ads between games, and a banner in the side column on large screens. There are never ads during play or in online matches.
ads.p2: Until you agree, we ask Google for non-personalised ads and deny ad cookies (Google Consent Mode). Visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom and Switzerland see Google's consent message (IAB TCF v2.2); everyone else sees our own notice. Personalised ads, based on cookies and your interests, are used only if you allow them. If Google's message covers you, change or withdraw your consent with the "Privacy and cookie settings" button below.
ads.p3: For rewarded ads we record that a reward was granted (the time and the game) to apply the daily limit. We do not give Google your account data.
ads.p4: How Google uses data in ads is explained at policies.google.com/technologies/ads.
ads.p5: Ad removal (remove_ads), once it is offered, turns off the ads between games and the banner; rewarded ads stay optional.

rights.title: Your rights under the GDPR
rights.p1: Controller: Ayvago (ayvago.com). This section is given under Articles 13 and 14 of the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applies to visitors in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom (UK GDPR) and Switzerland.
rights.p2: We process your personal data to run the platform and your account, keep the leaderboards fair, prevent abuse and cheating, keep the service secure and, while ads are on, to show ads and apply the ad limits.
rights.p3: Legal bases: performance of the service you use (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR) for your account, scores and library; our legitimate interests in security, fair play and non-personalised ads (Art. 6(1)(f)); and your consent (Art. 6(1)(a)) for personalised ads and ad cookies, which you can withdraw on this page at any time without affecting earlier processing.
rights.p4: Your account data is stored in the EU (Google Firebase, europe-west1, Belgium). Some of our service providers, Google (Firebase, AdSense) and Vercel, may process data outside the EEA; such transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
rights.p5: We keep your data while your account exists. Unused guest accounts are deleted after 30 days, and deleting your account removes your data from our systems, except where we must keep it by law.
rights.p6: You have the right to access your data, to rectify it, to have it erased, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability, and to withdraw consent at any time. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.
rights.p7: Most requests can be made on your Profile page (download or delete your data); for anything else, use the contact below.
